evidence_API_review.detail: FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes/store_buffer copy complete original bytes. Source SHA is checked before/after and copied SHA must match; destinations must be new. Only the owned output/cfg_evidence directory is created; actual campaign.cfg is never overwritten by the evidence helper.

Array/Dictionary typed builtin, class-name and script-null metadata use the real 4.6.3 API. Values.semantics supplies the actual safe per-value ConfigFile canonical text and Variant type; no unsupported object is introduced into CFG evidence.

Transaction.new inherits the actual read-only SnapshotStore constructor. Transaction.directory, _verified(name), _chain() and STAGES are real APIs; names and decoded revisions/SHA are recorded and each actual closed pair is copied before subsequent production pruning.

Each case before/after and final snapshot fresh-load the actual CFG, preserve all original raw bytes and SHA, expose all progress fields and top-level typed metadata, and record the retained journal plus candidate-stage inventory. Unknown/extra files or directories fail evidence rather than being repaired.

Seven actual successful commits are recorded after existing commit_prepared calls: first_progress, best_0 through best_3, legal_seed and legal_progress. The request/intent/original SHA/actual receipt and immediate physical CFG SHA/pair are available for independent host cross-validation. No extra commit or gameplay/result publication is added.

The original lawful fourteen unknown values have pre-save canonical semantics and typed metadata frozen before the existing physical prefs commit; the subsequent real progress commit and fresh-read evidence retain their semantics/type information.

journal_retention_review.note: Copies preserve the actual pair existing at each commit. The production directory still follows its two-record retention policy; fourteen records are historical evidence copies, not fourteen simultaneously retained production files.

future_producer_requirements: Use the pinned complete ordered contract for all data109 checks/case ordering and each QA mode20, including dynamic labels and all three branch-specific assertions. Header identity fields must use the exact six-field order.

Pin the first raw bytes/SHA of every CFG/journal evidence copy, report and native log; validate owned output/profile paths, no-links, exact inventories, process PID/nonce/terminal marker and current installed source identity.

Decode all fourteen copied original journal envelopes/documents with exact field types, magic/owner/scope/generation/previous-SHA chain, prepared/applied proposal equality, actual request/intent bindings and receipt CFG SHA. Match each declared head SHA to the last copied record SHA; do not trust helper ok/count alone.

Validate native before/after CFG canonical semantics, type metadata, complete progress/unlocked/records and the fourteen unknown values against their frozen pre-save expectations and raw files. Verify invalid exact requests/refusals and unchanged original CFG/source journal inventory.

Require an actually fresh private data profile for genuinely missing CFG, separate fresh QA1 profiles for the two QA cases, and SDK disabled. Retain only actual final13/14 in the production CFG journal; do not change pruning.

A new host/runtime source seal and independent stage admission are still required; this preliminary source review does not repair the rejected original19 V1 producer or grant native/all19/UI/SDK/full-goal execution.
qualification_note: Static preliminary review only of the six pure projection/CFG/Variant data cases and evidence additions, plus source-derived complete label contract. No new producer was reviewed or run, no Godot/native was started, and no running durable batch was polled or controlled. Historical source/reviews/failures remain immutable.
